decision.description: Resume Exp2 training from epoch 30 checkpoint to epoch 100
reasoning: Exp2 shows monotonic improvement trajectory (best=epoch29, still improving at epoch 30)
Exp2 improved 3 of 4 classes vs Exp1 on frozen India test (+56% longitudinal, +17% pothole, +12% alligator)
Dataset B provides 347x more transverse crack examples (7,313 vs 21) addressing the critical failure class
More training is lower risk than data collection
False positive issue solvable via threshold tuning (99.5% FPs are low confidence) — no new data needed
top_3_evidence: Exp2 improved 3/4 classes vs Exp1 on held-out India test (mAP50-95 0.111 vs 0.090, +23%)
decision.main_risk: Dataset B domain gap (68% mAP50-95 drop to India test) means additional data may not immediately improve India performance
